```{r}
#| echo: true

init_fun <- function(init_mu = 90, init_sigma = 15,
                     init_gamma = 0.01, init_lambda = 0.01) {
  list(
    mu         = rep(init_mu, datistan$nsubj),
    sigma      = rep(init_sigma, datistan$nsubj),
    gamma      = rep(init_gamma, datistan$nsubj),
    lambda     = rep(init_lambda, datistan$nsubj),
    MU           = init_mu,
    log_SIGMA    = log(init_sigma)
  )
}
```

```{stan}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| output.var: "dummy"

model {
  MU ~ normal(0, tau_MU);
  log_SIGMA ~ normal(0, tau_SIGMA);
  tau_mu ~ cauchy(0,2.5);
  tau_sigma ~ cauchy(0,2.5);
  tau_MU ~ cauchy(0,2.5);
  tau_SIGMA ~ cauchy(0,2.5);
  for (i in 1:nsubj){
    mu[i] ~ normal(MU, tau_mu);
    sigma[i] ~ lognormal(log_SIGMA, tau_sigma);
    gamma[i] ~ uniform(0, 1);
    lambda[i] ~ uniform(0, 1 - gamma[i]);
  }
  for (i in 1:nobs){
    y[i] ~ binomial(n[i], PI[i]);
  }
}
```
